core_features: field classification and routed scholarly discovery
idea, hypothesis, experiment, risk, and decision support
2-3-role manuscript audit with separate Lean, Pint, SymPy, Z3, numerical-protocol, OpenReview, image-integrity, evidence, code, and experiment checks
academic language, translation, venue-grounded writing, and defensive-writing checks
SVG/PDF/PNG academic figures and statistical plots
structured paper ingestion and source-located claim-evidence graphs
extended collision search over patents, trials, grants, datasets, software, and preregistrations
preregistration, statistical consistency, resource-bounded reproducibility, active review, and record-health monitoring
research artifacts, provenance graph, domain-Skill quarantine and SkillOpt
15-tool local MCP server and lifecycle hooks

components.label: Core research runtime
features: all core features including Pint dimensional, SymPy algebraic, Z3 constraint, numerical-protocol, OpenReview, and image-integrity checks; except real TeX compile and Lean verification

components.label: Portable MiKTeX
components.network_route: offline basic installer; TUNA CTAN mirror for explicitly approved extra packages
components.license: MiKTeX redistribution terms and package-specific licenses

components.label: External structured parser adapters
components.network_route: domestic package/model mirrors when supported; otherwise 127.0.0.1:7897
components.license: selected backend license and model terms; must be reviewed before installation
features: Docling, GROBID, MinerU, or Marker normalized JSON input
layout/table/formula/OCR locators when supplied by the chosen backend
components.selection_note: Research Guard does not install or execute these heavy stacks automatically; supply a project-local normalized parser output.

components.label: Advanced statistics backends
components.network_route: Tsinghua or other domestic Python/R mirrors first; otherwise 127.0.0.1:7897
components.license: SciPy BSD-3-Clause; statsmodels BSD-3-Clause; statcheck is comparison-only GPL-3.0
features: independent numeric oracle for core recomputation
components.selection_note: Core APA-like recomputation works without this component; no automatic installation is currently provided.

components.label: ASReview specialist UI/backend
components.selection_note: Core human-owned screening prioritization remains available without ASReview.
